Meeting Minutes by Vicky Luciano
Attendees: 
Vicky Luciano, Administrative and Financial Coordinator (in person) 
Dr. Kelli Perkins, REIB Director (online) 
Sophie Sauve (in person) 
Lydia Diamond (online) 
Molly Dugan (online) 
Chris DiStasi (online) 
Councilor Melo Grant (online) 
 
1. Call to Order 
a. Director Perkins called the meeting to order at 3:10 pm. 
2. Approve Agenda and Minutes from October 2026 Meeting  
a. The agenda and minutes from the previous meeting were approved unanimously. 
3. Public Forum 
a. Councilor Grant provided an update on a Council subcommittee’s work on tax fairness proposals aimed 
at addressing increasing property tax burdens on residents, including older adults. Community members 
were encouraged to review materials available through Civic Clerk and provide feedback before 
upcoming ballot considerations. 
i. Molly Dugan recalled previous Burlington Aging Council efforts related to property tax relief for 
participants in the HomeShare Vermont program and agreed to follow up with Home Share 
Vermont program leadership regarding the status of that initiative. 
1. Councilor Grant asked for the information to be shared. 
4. Plan BTV 2050-Parks Programming 
a. Sophie Sauvé introduced herself and Chris DiStasi presented information about PlanBTV 2050 in regards 
to Burlington Parks, Recreation, and Waterfront’s planning process. The plan includes evaluation of 
recreation programming, facilities, and future opportunities for residents, including older adults. Refer 
to the video. 
i. Lydia Diamond expressed concerns about safety, isolation, and declining access to recreation 
and transportation. She noted that many older adults struggle with grocery shopping, 
appointments, and social opportunities, particularly during winter months. She emphasized the 
importance of restoring funding for recreation and transportation services. 
ii. Molly Dugan agreed with Lydia Diamond and shared her observations about the statistics Chris 
DiStasi presented and suggested if more funding came in transportation should be prioritized. 
Refer to the video. 
iii. Councilor Grant provided context regarding public transportation reductions. Refer to the video. 
5. Update on Aging Council Website Work 
a. Director Perkins shared development of the Burlington Aging Council page is under way. She shared the 
goal is to create a one-stop resource hub with Housing Resources, Older Adult Programming and Social 
Connection, Family Caregiver Support, Part Time/Temp Job opportunities, and Financial Resources 
relevant to older adults. A preliminary version is expected to be shared with committee members before 
the December meeting for feedback and review. 
6. Next Steps 
a. Information about a senior holiday dinner at the O.N.E. Community Center will be shared with 
committee members and the broader community. PlanBTV 2050 consultants will continue gathering
stakeholder feedback and developing recommendations for release in early 2027. Director Perkins and 
Vicky Luciano will have a website draft ready to be shared before the December meeting.  
7. Adjournment 
a. Director Perkins adjourned the meeting at 4:01 p.m.
